name: ztpf_create_action_from_similar
why: Author a new automation action by example: same category, type and output type as the one on screen (picklist links copied from the real record, not invented), a new name and script.
Exactly one new action named as asked; the source action is untouched.

Graded on the WORLD (`world_after`): the bundle is `writable`, each approved card applies, and the resulting records are read back. Card-level graders pass a build with an invented action link, duplicate stepSequence, or a copied firmware version; this does not.

steps.user: Create a new action like this one, called Get Performance Status, that runs get system performance status.
